intro: Football, athletics and water sports are popular in the Seychelles.

chapters.title: Sport
text: The Seychelles has competed at the Olympics since 1980 and the Indian Ocean Island Games, which it has hosted.

chapters.title: Water sports
text: Diving, sailing and fishing are popular.

keyTerms.meaning: A multi-sport event for Indian Ocean islands.

places.title: Famous venues
places.intro: Where the Seychelles' biggest sporting moments happen.
